items.html: And now it is the phase of the Tzadi of the Tzelem alone, and it is the phase of the ZA, in which the Mochin expanded a third expansion and entered within ZA itself, in the secret of internal Mochin, and not surrounding. And the reason it is now called the Tzadi of the Tzelem is that these four Mochin, when clothed within the NHY of the third Tevuna, become only three, for the HG become one Daat; and these three Mochin, being clothed within the NHY of Tevuna, descended and clothed within ZA, as said, and first enter into the Galgalta, and afterward expand in all his body, as said in other discourses, later, God willing. And it is known that ZA is nine Sefirot and not more, and each one is included of ten, and they are ninety; therefore these Mochin, which expand in all of ZA, are called the Tzadi of the Tzelem.
